records.description: Photo your fridge, get a recipe. AI-powered meal inspiration for household cooks. As FridgeAI learns your likes and dislikes, it will recommend suitable recipes. Tell it what you have in your pantry, dietary restrictions, time-limits. Cook with what you have also is good for the environment and you'll reduce food waste! Invite your partner as co-chef and you'll share the "kitchen".

records.name: Chain
records.tagline: Build unstoppable habits by never breaking the chain.
records.description: Cognu Chain is the digital "red marker" for your daily non-negotiables. Inspired by Jerry Seinfeld’s legendary productivity method, it’s designed for one thing: momentum. - Declare: Set your daily commitment. - Log: Write a brief note on your progress each day. - Visualize: Watch your streak grow across your calendar. No bloat, no complex sub-tasks, just the visual pressure to never break the chain. Turn your daily effort into an unstoppable streak.

records.name: VibeInvite
records.tagline: Set the vibe. Track the RSVPs. Capture the memories.
records.description: VibeInvite is a simple tool designed to help parents simplify party planning. Instead of juggling group texts and lost paper invites, you get one easy link to track RSVPs, plus the ability to print out matching physical cards for school. It also features a private, secure photo wall where pictures can be shared easily.

records.name: uuProxy
records.tagline: Deploy your dedicated VPN servers on AWS, GCP instantly
records.description: uuProxy is a dedicated VPN infrastructure platform built entirely on a WordPress + WooCommerce framework to provide a seamless, e-commerce-style experience for network privacy. Users can purchase a VPN server as a digital product and have it provisioned instantly. Supports two protocol suites: V2Ray: VMess, VLESS, and DNSTT. WireGuard: WireGuard, AmneziaWG, and SOCKS5. Servers are deployed on enterprise-grade infrastructure including AWS Lightsail/EC2, Google Cloud, and Alibaba Cloud.

records.name: Momentum planner
records.tagline: The weekly planner built around energy
records.description: Most planning tools optimise your schedule. Momentum helps you understand it. It’s a weekly planner built around energy awareness. Plan your week based on realistic capacity, adapt as things change, and reflect on how it actually felt. Over time, it reveals patterns behind overcommitment, avoidance, and burnout. Designed for people balancing full modern lives, especially those who feel overwhelmed by traditional productivity systems, including many neurodivergent users.

records.name: StudioLayer
records.tagline: The all-in-one workspace for film and music creators
records.description: Filmmakers and musicians juggle 12 disconnected tools. StudioLayer puts the entire workflow in one place: scripts, shot lists, storyboards, audio markers with MIDI export to your DAW, IP protection, a stock marketplace, courses, and a creators-only social feed. AI handles the busywork — reels, lyrics, cue sheets, scene breakdowns — so you focus on the craft. Built by an audiovisual creator, for creators.

records.name: PDF AGENT ASSIST
records.tagline: AI-powered desktop workspace for large PDF workflows
records.description: PDF Agent Assist is an AI-powered desktop workspace for large PDF workflows on macOS and Windows. Open large documents, select text directly from any page, and get instant AI-powered explanations, summaries, and contextual answers inside the app. Built for faster document understanding with smart prompts, clean navigation, and an optimized architecture designed to reduce the performance limitations common in traditional RAG-based PDF tools.

records.name: LaunchApp AI Starter Templates
records.tagline: Save the tokens, Build Fast
records.description: Production-ready SaaS templates, autonomously maintained. Ship faster with React Router, Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, and more. Everything you need to get your product launched, stop spending on tokens and start building what counts.

records.name: Online Notepad
records.tagline: Secure Online Notepad for Quick Notes
records.description: Note is a fast, secure online notepad by iiniit for quick notes, drafts, ideas, and temporary text storage. Create PIN-protected notes instantly without signup. Just enter an ID and start writing from anywhere. Built for simplicity, privacy, and speed.

records.name: Spanglish Translator
records.tagline: Porque sometimes one language no es enough.
records.description: Standard translators fail when you mix English y Español. Meet Spanglish Translator! Built specifically for modern bilingual code-switching. Whether you're browsing social media, reading chats, or learning conversational slang, our browser extension provides instant, culturally accurate translations that actually make sense. Stop relying on rigid dictionary apps that don't understand how real people talk. Highlight any text, get the real meaning, and experience the web in tu idioma!

records.name: PII Blackout
records.tagline: Offline AI tool to auto-redact PII from your documents
records.description: PII Blackout: Secure, Local AI PDF Redaction Protect data with our high-security desktop tool. Powered by local AI, it auto-identifies and wipes PII (names, IDs, etc.) with one click. • 100% Offline: Data stays on your device—no cloud, no leaks. • AI + Manual: Auto-detect or manually mask areas for total precision. • Batch Work: Redact multiple PDFs at once. • Secure Export: Redacted content is permanently purged. Fast, safe, and professional.

records.name: PopsicleBoat
records.tagline: a community platform for creators and shared interests
records.description: Stick together. I’ve been building PopsicleBoat, a community site where people can join interest-based spaces, post what they’re making, and keep a portfolio organized by community. Right now it supports public/private posts, comments, likes, community pages, user profiles, role/admin tools, etc. It is meant to be a quieter community focused experience, so you can enjoy and post your content without the noise other online communities foster.

records.name: Fireside
records.tagline: Custom deal pages that sell when the rep isn’t there
records.description: Sales decks are static. Buyers open them, you get an email-open notification, and the deal goes quiet. We turned the deck into a configurable instrument. The buyer drags sliders to scope deal size, calculators for ROI, dropdowns for what they want. Sellers see exactly what was configured — not "spent 3 minutes on pricing" but "CFO scoped 120 trucks at the Accelerate plan." Different data class. Doesn't exist anywhere else in the sales stack.

records.name: UpperClass
records.tagline: AI-native student creator marketplace for brands & unis.
records.description: UpperClass is a premier Student Creator Marketplace designed for Universities and Brands. As a dedicated GenZ creator platform, it enables institutions to activate students for NIL campaigns, recruitment storytelling, and enrollment marketing. Brands leverage UpperClass to access a vetted network of campus ambassadors and student influencers for authentic localized activations. Built with AI-native efficiency, UpperClass is the definitive bridge between higher education and the creator economy.

records.name: Fluxx: Fitness & Psychology
records.tagline: It's about HOW you change, not only what you change.
records.description: Fluxx — the fitness app that doesn't give you a plan. Plans fail because change is hard. Too much change at once causes the brain to resist, hence why fitness apps have terrible retention rates. Instead, Fluxx watches how you already train, then uses behavioural science to introduce one small change at a time. Small enough to stick, but tailored exactly to what your goal needs. No overhauls. No "6-week transformation". Just compounding progress. For gym-goers who want a system, not a gimmick.

records.name: Transition
records.tagline: AI coach to help you train smarter and race faster
records.description: Eliminate guesswork and race faster with training that adapts to you. Whether you're preparing for a sprint triathlon, 5k, Ironman, or marathon, Transition delivers adaptive swim, bike, run, and strength workouts designed to improve endurance, power, and race performance.

records.name: Greysound
records.tagline: A pro recording studio that engineers itself
records.description: Digital Audio Workstations (nerd-speak for "software used by audio engineers to record, edit, mix and master audio") look like airplane cockpits. You can do an entire four-year degree in audio engineering. Someone who just wants to make music should not have to also learn audio engineering. Greysound is a DAW with a native AI CoProducer that does all the engineering while humans focus on their craft.

records.name: Scout.kids
records.tagline: AI to help mom find kids events
records.description: Moms spend hours per week browsing parent blogs, city calendars, instagram, library websites, etc. just to find activities for their kids to do. Worse, they do it late at night when they should be sleeping, and they still miss things. Scout.kids bring it all together in one place: a complete inventory of every kid event in your city so mom can find activities seconds, not hours. Our agents are crawling cities right now on behalf of moms, everywhere.

records.name: Roux
records.tagline: AI-powered personal cooking assistant
records.description: Roux guides you through every meal, from planning your week to making dishes that impress. Roux lets you to engage with your recipes like never before. Ask questions, adjust ingredients, and get feedback while you cook. Plus, Roux adapts to your tastes and cooking habits. The more you use the app, the better the assistance becomes.

records.name: Asset Management Software
records.tagline: Asset Management Software for Real Time Asset Visibility
records.description: Managing assets manually becomes difficult as operations grow. Businesses often struggle with misplaced equipment, inaccurate inventory records, unexpected downtime, and limited visibility across locations. Asset management software helps organizations track, monitor, and manage assets in real time, improving operational control and reducing inefficiencies.

records.name: Tweetmonials
records.tagline: Turn X praise into testimonials and trust signals
records.description: Tweetmonials helps founders, creators, and SaaS teams turn real praise from X into beautiful testimonials, badges, collages, and embeddable social proof. What you can do: ✅ Create testimonial cards from tweet links ✅ Build multi-card collages ✅ Create social proof badges ✅ Embed testimonials anywhere ✅ Organize praise with Spaces ✅ Increase trust and conversions Built for founders who know trust sells.

records.name: Public Pages for Confluence
records.tagline: Publish branded, SEO-friendly content from Confluence
records.description: TypeSwitch builds Confluence Cloud apps that turn internal pages into public, branded, search-friendly websites. Teams keep content in Confluence and publish clean URLs with SEO titles, meta descriptions, analytics, indexing controls, and custom domains. Its Public Pages for Confluence app lets you manage SEO and branding in one place, preview public pages, and sync updates without rebuilding content in another CMS.

records.name: FoxTrail — Explore, Write, Snap
records.tagline: Write on the world anonymously. Every photo & place is real.
records.description: What if you could leave a secret message anywhere and a stranger finds it walking by? That's FoxTrail. Every photo is shot live (gallery blocked), every location is GPS-verified (spoofing detected), every device is fingerprinted (no fake accounts), and content is filtered in 16 languages. Write anonymously at real places. Discover nearby messages. Chat without names. After 50 messages, both choose to reveal or stay anonymous forever. No bots. No fakes. Just honest words at real locations.

records.name: Cimé
records.tagline: Designed to reduce, not stimulate.
records.description: Most apps compete for your attention. Cimé does the opposite. It's a calm, editorial digital space; no feeds, no streaks, no pressure. Just room to set a daily intention, reflect, take notes, and explore a curated collection of ideas and imagery. We call this editorial tech. A new category of software shaped by restraint and meaning, rather than speed and engagement. Cimé doesn't try to fill your time. It creates space. First edition. Quiet by design.

records.name: Humanly
records.tagline: Strip the AI. Keep the message.
records.description: AI emails all sound the same. Em-dashes. "Hope this finds you well." Recruiters clock it in seconds. Humanly lives inside Gmail. Hit Humanize, drag a slider - Subtle, Human, or CEO. Rewrites in 2 seconds, highlights every change. No servers. No accounts. Your API key, your model. Free. Open source.

records.name: Monezzi
records.tagline: Form and run your US company from anywhere
records.description: Monezzi helps global founders form and operate a US company without getting lost in paperwork, compliance, or banking issues. We combine company formation, EIN support, invoicing, payments, bookkeeping, and compliance tracking into one platform. Built by a founder with 25+ years in fintech and marketplace infrastructure, Monezzi is designed for non-US entrepreneurs who want to build real businesses in the US market.

records.name: Reflex
records.tagline: Infrastructure that reacts before you do.
records.description: Reflex monitors your production servers and fixes problems before they become outages. A lightweight agent watches for common failure patterns — memory leaks, failed deployments, queue backlogs, permission drift, process crashes — and triggers automated repair playbooks to resolve them without waking you up. Works across your entire stack: PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Python, and many more. If it runs on a Linux server, Reflex can monitor and heal it.

records.name: LegalOps360
records.tagline: Enterprise Legal Ops Platform, at an SMB Price Tag
records.description: LegalOps360 is the system of record for SMB legal teams — matter management, e-billing with violation detection, vendor management, compliance intelligence across 10 frameworks, and a Second Opinion AI panel. Enterprise legal ops capability, without the enterprise price tag. Listed on Capterra. If you run a lean legal team, manage outside counsel relationships, or are the one person holding together your company's legal operations on spreadsheets and email threads, LegalOps360 is built for you.

records.name: Noteweave
records.tagline: Go from research to executable production plans in hours
records.description: Noteweave is an automated RnD lab. It helps teams to go from research to executable production plans in hours. 1. Stress test scientific research with Noteweave's E3 - surpasses Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT 5.4 on technical fault finding. 2. Deeply analyse research works that work for you in your domain. 3. Create an executable production plan for your product. 4. Noteweave is available right within your favorite IDE.
